desc: Trigger warning: blood and biohazard cleanup footage. Where do you start when an accident leaves a hotel room covered in biohazard contamination? The biohazard waste from this cleanup goes to a dedicated facility for proper disposal. I’m sharing the work behind hotel accident cleanup—from that first walkthrough to removing the biggest source of biohazard.
